# UNK-379 raw-route allowlist
#
# Canonical registry of raw axum `.route(...)` registrations exempted from
# the OpenApiRouter + `routes!(...)` requirement. CI greps for `.route(` in
# `backend/src/` and rejects any line not containing a fixed string from
# this file (`grep -v -F -f`).
#
# Adding an entry: include reviewer justification in the PR description
# adding it. The exempt class must be one of:
#   1. Test-only ad-hoc routers inside `#[cfg(test)]` modules — never part
#      of the shipped router, so no OpenAPI documentation applies.
#   2. Operational / standard-protocol paths deliberately kept on plain
#      routing (none today; a new entry of this class needs an ADR or
#      debt/ pointer).
#
# Pattern styles mirror .github/sqlx-runtime-allowlist.txt:
#   - `path:` prefixes act as file-level blankets: every `.route(` in that
#     file is exempted. Use only when the entire file's raw routing falls
#     under one exempt class.
#   - other substrings scope the exemption to specific call shapes.

# (1) error/instance.rs file-blanket — #[cfg(test)] router exercising
# problem_instance_layer URI capture; not a shipped endpoint
backend/src/error/instance.rs:
